title: Get Regular — Trust Your Gut Again
description: AI-powered gut health tracking. Analyze your stool, meals, and biomarkers for personalized insights — built with a board-certified gastroenterologist.
h1: Your gut is talking. Are you listening?
h2: You've been flushing your most powerful biomarker.
We turn gut feelings into gut data.
Built with a gastroenterologist, not just an algorithm.
Fresh reads for a happier gut.
h3: What Your Poop Is Trying to Tell You
paragraphs: AI-POWERED · CLINICALLY VALIDATED · AVAILABLE ON IOS
Get Regular analyzes your stool, meals, symptoms and biomarkers to give you personalized insights.
Photo your food, stool, and symptoms. Ten seconds, done.
AI cross-references everything against clinical GI guidance to find your patterns.
Your daily Gut and Nutrition scores update in real time with every input.
Personalized dietary and supplement recommendations built from your data. Not anyone else’s.
Track what’s moving the needle. Your plan evolves as your gut does.
Thousands of people are already tracking, learning, and feeling better. Here's what they're saying.

Not to be dramatic, it’s only been 2 days — but I feel like it’s kind of life changing. Love having something to help keep me accountable to my own gut health and actually think about it on a daily basis. So cool and always such a fan of women’s health innovation.
As someone with celiac disease, it’s so refreshing to use an app that doesn’t reduce every bit of discomfort to your autoimmune condition. It feels really validating and thoughtful.
Just downloaded and have been using this app for a few days now. This is exactly what I’ve been looking for. From a girl with chronic constipation — thank you!!!

I just downloaded it and this is EXACTLY what I have been needing. I’ve been trying to track my gut health for a little bit but never had anything streamlined. I already started using it and it’s amazing! The way it gives you information immediately. This is mindblowing — they’ve created something spectacular.
Developed with a board-certified gastroenterologist, we bring the best of clinical expertise and holistic insight into one easy, daily app experience.

The app's internal analysis and outputs underwent extensive scrutiny and tweaking to ensure it correctly follows all current major gastroenterology guidelines as it relates to gut health — reliably demonstrating that the app provides users with a convenient, evidence-based interpretation of their personal digestive wellbeing.
A friendly guide to the Bristol Stool Scale, the 7-type chart doctors actually use to talk about poop.
